usedFor: Content events in ButterCMS, like “Collection Item Published”, sign someone up through “Register Attendee for Webinar” in Zoom.

bestTemplate.name: “Collection Item Published” in ButterCMS, then “Register Attendee for Webinar” in Zoom
bestTemplate.why: Publishing is a clear moment to act, and the action registers an attendee for a Zoom webinar.

watchOut: “Collection Item Draft Saved” also fires, so choose “Collection Item Published” to avoid registering attendees on drafts.
